Geospatial and Movement Ecology
Position Description
Are you passionate about integrating wildlife research, big data, and geospatial analyses? The CKWRI Spatial Analytics Laboratory and Technology hub (C-SALT) is seeking a highly motivated PhD student to work on an exciting project at the intersection of movement ecology, geospatial science, and computational biology.
The successful candidate will lead a research project focused on integrating large-scale animal movement datasets (e.g., GPS, VHF telemetry) with diverse geospatial data layers (e.g., satellite imagery, climate data…

Management of Grazing for Multiple Socio-ecological Services
Position Description
Grazing management involves many interrelated and interdependent variables dealing with climate, soils, water and nutrient cycles, plant communities, livestock and wildlife populations, and economics. Although considerable research exits on the relationships between grazing and individual ecological or financial indicators, much remains to be learned about the interconnected trade-offs (spatially and temporally) among the various components through a systems approach to grazing management. Using virtual fencing to manage cattle grazing distribution for Northern Bobwhite habitat improvement on working rangelands
Project Description
We are recruiting one Ph.D. student to conduct research which aims to evaluate the use of virtual fencing as a tool for targeted grazing management to improve quail habitat on working rangelands. The successful candidate will integrate ruminant nutrition, precision livestock management, rangeland ecology, and wildlife habitat management.
The project offers an opportunity to work at the intersection of animal science, precision livestock management, rangeland ecology, and wildlife conservation. This research will evaluate how…

Population Dynamics of North Pacific Albatrosses
Position Description
We are seeking a highly motivated Ph.D. student to pursue research that bridges seabird ecology, demographic modeling, and wildlife conservation. The successful candidate will leverage extensive long-term datasets to understand the intrinsic and extrinsic factors driving populations of two species of North Pacific albatrosses – Laysan Albatross (Mōlī) and Black-footed Albatross (Ka‘upu). The research will primarily focus on breeding colonies at Midway Atoll, with potential expansion to include populations on other islands. This project…

PH. D. Assistantship(s), M.S. Assistantships(s)
Space Use and Resource Selection of White-winged Doves in The Non-Breeding Season
Position Description
We are recruiting one Ph.D. student or one MS student to conduct research which broadly aims to assess the space use and resource selection of White-winged Doves (Zenaida asiatica) in South Texas in the non-breeding season to expand on work currently being conducted in the Smith Lab at The Caesar Kleberg Wildlife Research Institute, Texas A&M-Kingsville. We will achieve these goals via a coordinated telemetry and banding program in South Texas that permits assessments of movements and resource selection at multiple-spatial scales.…

Strategies and technologies to enhance habitat restoration of degraded rangelands
Position Description
We are seeking a highly motivated M.S. or Ph.D. student to work on an exciting project at the intersection of restoration ecology, geospatial data science and ecological modeling. The graduate student selected will conduct research on habitat restoration of degraded rangelands (e.g., energy extraction, woody plant encroachment, and rangeland conversion). Project goals include using native species restoration, prescribed fire, and adaptive grazing to reduce the risks and impacts of drought and invasive plant species…

M.S. Assistantships(s)
Ecological Mechanisms Underlying Small Wild Cat Movements & Behavior of Ocelots and Bobcats Near Roads
Position Description
The Tewes Small Wild Cat Program of the Caesar Kleberg Wildlife Research Institute at Texas A&M University-Kingsville invites applications from highly motivated individuals to pursue a M.S. degree in our Cat Lab. Students will study ocelots and bobcats to investigate: (1) biotic and abiotic factors that influence movements, and (2) comparative variations in behavioral patterns for sympatric ocelot and bobcats, particularly locations near and distant from roads. Successful applicants will participate in all aspects of field…
[ Read More ]
Urban Trees, Community Greening, and Watershed Restoration
Position Description
We are seeking a highly motivated M.S. student to join a project at the intersection of restoration ecology, urban forestry, and geospatial science. This project will enhance regional ecological health and support long-term improvements in water quality. The chosen graduate student will conduct research on watershed restoration in South Texas, aiming to expand tree canopy cover through coordinated tree-planting efforts and community education to strengthen watershed protection. Project objectives include: 1) Conducting comprehensive…

Assessment of strategies to accelerate recovery of Masked Bobwhite Quail
Position Description
We are recruiting one MS student to conduct research which aims to assess strategies that can be used to accelerate the recovery of Masked Bobwhite, a critically endangered subspecies of the Northern Bobwhite. Previous efforts to recover Masked Bobwhite have focused on Buenos Aires National Wildlife Refuge, southern Arizona and have considered a variety of reintroduction techniques. Despite these efforts, a wild, self-sustaining population has not been achieved. To restore this iconic game bird this project will expand on previous…

Assistant Director, Texas Native Seeds
POSITION Description
The Assistant Director of Texas Native Seeds (TNS), under general direction, assists in leading and supervising the Coastal Prairies project. This position oversees daily operations of facilities, research sites, and demonstration projects across state, federal, and private lands. The role maintains strong partnerships with landowners and agencies while supporting technical initiatives, fundraising efforts, and strategic planning. The position is headquartered in Edna, Texas.
